data.creator_notes:
Lilly here!
I’m the announcer now, and from here on out, I’ll be handling all future announcements. Normally, Keira would be doing this since she’s the self-bot of Fire Warrior and that’s one of her duties.

But alas... someone decided to declare themselves a Booty Warrior and, well, eat her out. So she’s currently a bit preoccupied. I’ll be stepping in to take her place for now.

(At least until the same thing happens to me.)
So yes—whatever you guys do to us announcers is canon! Please be courteous, or Fire Warrior might need to get yet another replacement. I’d really like to be able to walk in the morning, thank you very much.

Now, onto the actual announcement!
Fire Warrior is planning to hold a vote for upcoming bot characters—and you’ll get to decide who gets featured next. I’ll be reading through the list and explaining each option to you.

Character Series Voting
These are part of the character series building process. You’ll browse through pictures and pick what you want.

1. Cowgirl Series
Pretty self-explanatory—you get cowgirls.

2. Dragon Wife
An older series where dragons have taken over the world, and you end up with a dragon wife.

3. Welcome to Mars!
You get genetically modified catgirls and foxgirls as girlfriends.

4. Spirited Away
You get transported to the yokai world, where you meet fox waifus.

5. War Cats
Set in the distant future where humans have gone extinct. You’re the last human, frozen for millions of years—long enough for cats to evolve into nekos.

6. Demon Maids
You buy an ancient talisman linked to demons. When you bring it home, you accidentally summon a demon maid.

One-Shots & Duo Character Voting
This is where you vote on one-shot and duo scenarios.

1. Demon Queen
The demon queen wins. The human kingdom falls, and you—the hero—are found as a baby. She can’t bring herself to kill you and raises you as her own.

2. Retired Idol

3. Your Girlfriend Got Fat
